summary: Join our Environmental Health Impact Assessment Training Course to gain essential skills in assessing health impacts and fostering environmental sustainability.
lede: Environmental health impact assessment (EHIA) examines how projects may affect environmental conditions and human health. For professionals involved in environmental, health or sustainability decisions, the training covers screening and scoping assessments, collecting and interpreting baseline data, and assessing health risks. Participants also practise planning mitigation, communicating findings with stakeholders, and setting up monitoring and review.
audienceIntro: This training is designed for professionals involved in environmental, health, or sustainability decision-making, including:
audience: Public health specialists and environmental scientists
Policy makers and planners in infrastructure
modules: Foundations of Environmental Health Impact Assessment
Health Risk Assessment and Impact Prediction
Mitigation and Environmental Health Management Planning
EHIA Report Writing and Quality Review
Emerging Issues and Global Best Practices
